title.narrative: PublicPrivate Infrastructure Advisory Facility SubNational Technical Assistance Program

description.narrative: The trust fund development objective is to provide financing for PPIAF sub-national technical assistance activities. This PPIAF sub-national program aims to strengthen sub-national government entities (municipalities, local utilities, etc.) so that they can access affordable private sector finance (from banks or bond markets) on commercial terms, without sovereign government guarantees.

participating-org.narrative: Australia - Ministry for Foreign Affairs and Trade
French Development Agency (Agence Française de Developpement)
Italy - Ministry of Foreign Affairs International Cooperation
State Secretariat for Economic Affairs, SECO
